subject: Maths
cover: Class 12 Derivatives: the rules you'll use everywhere

slides.headline: Power rule
slides.sub: d/dx (xⁿ) = n·xⁿ⁻¹

slides.headline: Trig derivatives
slides.sub: d/dx (sin x) = cos x · d/dx (cos x) = −sin x · d/dx (tan x) = sec²x

slides.headline: Exponential & log
slides.sub: d/dx (eˣ) = eˣ · d/dx (ln x) = 1/x

slides.headline: Product rule
slides.sub: (uv)′ = u′v + uv′

slides.headline: Quotient rule
slides.sub: (u/v)′ = (u′v − uv′) / v²

slides.headline: Chain rule
slides.sub: dy/dx = (dy/du) × (du/dx)

slides.headline: Power rule
slides.sub: ∫ xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1) + C, where n ≠ −1

slides.headline: Reciprocal
slides.sub: ∫ (1/x) dx = ln|x| + C

slides.headline: Exponential
slides.sub: ∫ eˣ dx = eˣ + C

slides.headline: Trig integrals
slides.sub: ∫ sin x dx = −cos x + C · ∫ cos x dx = sin x + C · ∫ sec²x dx = tan x + C

slides.headline: Integration by parts
slides.sub: ∫ u·v dx = u∫v dx − ∫ (u′ · ∫v dx) dx

slides.headline: Dot (scalar) product
slides.sub: a · b = |a||b| cos θ = a₁b₁ + a₂b₂ + a₃b₃ (gives a number)

slides.headline: Cross (vector) product
slides.sub: |a × b| = |a||b| sin θ (gives a vector ⟂ to both)

slides.headline: Perpendicular & parallel
slides.sub: a · b = 0 ⇒ perpendicular · a × b = 0 ⇒ parallel

slides.headline: Projection
slides.sub: Projection of a on b = (a · b) / |b|

slides.headline: Conditional probability
slides.sub: P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B), where P(B) ≠ 0

slides.headline: Multiplication theorem
slides.sub: P(A ∩ B) = P(A) · P(B|A)

slides.headline: Independent events
slides.sub: If A and B are independent: P(A ∩ B) = P(A) · P(B)

slides.headline: Bayes' theorem (idea)
slides.sub: Updates the probability of a cause given an observed event, using prior probabilities.

slides.headline: Coulomb's law
slides.sub: F = (1/4πε₀) · (q₁q₂ / r²), where k = 1/4πε₀ = 9 × 10⁹ N·m²/C²

slides.headline: Electric field
slides.sub: E = F/q = kq / r² · Unit: N/C or V/m

slides.headline: Electric potential
slides.sub: V = kq / r · Unit: volt (V)

slides.headline: Relation E and V
slides.sub: E = −dV/dr (field points from high to low potential)

slides.headline: Magnification
slides.sub: m = v/u = height of image / height of object

slides.headline: Power of a lens
slides.sub: P = 1/f (f in metres) · Unit: dioptre (D)

subject: Physics
cover: Modern Physics: the formulas that win marks

slides.headline: Photon energy
slides.sub: E = hν = hc/λ, where h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s

slides.headline: Photoelectric equation
slides.sub: hν = φ₀ + ½mv²max (Einstein's equation, φ₀ = work function)

slides.headline: de Broglie wavelength
slides.sub: λ = h/p = h/(mv) — matter behaves like a wave

slides.headline: Mass–energy equivalence
slides.sub: E = mc² (Einstein)
